layout.hierarchy: Red title dominates at top; blue chart title second; the scatter plot with orange points is the main visual; purple dashed annotation lines draw attention to the y-axis question marks; small model box is secondary

visual_elements.description: Scatter plot, no axis tick numbers. Y-axis labeled 'Weight' (vertical red text, left), X-axis labeled 'Length' (red text, bottom right). Approximately 20 orange/brown circular dots forming a positive linear trend from lower-left to upper-right. A vertical purple dashed line rises from a purple dot on the x-axis (around x=60% of plot width) up to near the top of the data; four horizontal purple dashed lines extend left from points on/near this vertical line to the y-axis, each ending at a purple dot on the y-axis; beside these y-axis dots are four red question marks '? ? ? ?' stacked vertically. A thin brown dotted vertical line appears slightly right of the purple dashed line, and thin brown dotted horizontal lines extend from the y-axis to the data points near the vertical line. A small black cursor arrow points at a data point near the vertical dashed line. No numeric axis values shown.
Rectangular box with thin border containing three lines: 'Model' in red underlined bold, 'I/P:  Length' in black bold, 'O/P: Weight' in black bold
Yellow circle badge with black number '4' (slide number)
Thick dark-red rectangular border framing the entire slide content area

imagery: Small black mouse-cursor arrow icon pointing at a scatter point near the vertical dashed line, center of plot
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout; title large bold dark red; chart title bold blue; axis labels bold red (y-axis rotated 90°); model box text bold with red underlined heading; question marks red bold
animation_state: Appears fully built; the four red question marks on the y-axis indicate an in-progress explanation (predicting possible weight outputs for a given length), but no partially revealed bullets
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F5F5F5). 2. Draw a thick dark-red (#8B0000) rectangle border framing the whole slide with small margins. 3. Add centered bold dark-red title at top: 'Regression – One Dimensional Case'. 4. Add yellow (#FFFF99) circle with black '4' at top-right. 5. Add bold blue (#0000CC) centered text below title: 'Length and Weight of  different samples of Steel Bars' (note double space after 'of'). 6. Draw scatter plot axes: vertical red arrow axis labeled 'Weight' (rotated red text) on left, horizontal red arrow axis labeled 'Length' at bottom right; no tick marks or numbers. 7. Plot ~20 orange-brown (#D2691E) dots in an upward linear trend from lower-left to upper-right. 8. Draw a vertical purple dashed line from a purple dot on the x-axis up through the data cloud; add a thin brown dotted vertical line just to its right. 9. Draw four horizontal purple dashed lines from the vertical line leftward to the y-axis, ending in four purple dots on the y-axis; place four red bold '?' marks stacked beside them. 10. Add thin brown dotted horizontal lines from y-axis to nearby data points. 11. Add a white box with thin border at right-middle containing: 'Model' (red, bold, underlined), 'I/P:  Length' (black bold), 'O/P: Weight' (black bold). 12. Optionally add a small black cursor arrow near the central data points.
